title: Chapter 376: Fierce Battle With Spear And Shield Soldiers
content:
Chapter 376: Fierce Battle With Spear And Shield Soldiers

When selecting his subordinates, Wang Shuo noticed that the generals were selected from the organized troops, and everyone had a deep understanding of this type of soldiers.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but sigh that those who could come here were really not easy to deal with.

However, the attributes of the soldiers were restrained, which led to the direct defeat of many teams with great potential.

Wang Shuo's alien beast cavalry was most afraid of the spear and shield soldiers.

As long as the opponent formed a turtle formation, the casualty ratio would still be higher.

The more you worry about something, the more likely it will happen.

In the third round, Wang Shuo encountered the spear and shield soldiers.

These soldiers were also served by military generals, and the combat effectiveness of a single military general was not much different from that summoned by Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo looked at it and saw that there were only two generals on the opposite side. It was good news that he had one more person on his side.

This battle was a tough battle.

Wang Shuo instructed Zhu Tianguo and another summoned general Cook.

"The three of us will rush directly into the enemy's camp, disrupt their defense, and then immediately escape the encirclement. Don't fight too much, just break through."

"Remember?"

"Yes, my lord."

Wang Shuo thought that with his general-level strength, it would be no problem to hold on for one or two minutes in the enemy's camp.

As long as the enemy's formation is broken up, the battle will be stable.

The enemy has only more than 40 people, and there are more than 50 people on our side.

Taking such a risky tactic is just to preserve the manpower to the maximum extent.

After formulating a good strategy, Wang Shuo immediately rode Da Huang and quickly approached the enemy's defensive formation.

Just when he was about to approach the opponent's spear, Da Huang suddenly stopped charging, and Wang Shuo used the huge inertia to jump into the defensive circle surrounded by shields.

Da Huang is not like other earth dragon beasts that can be exchanged from the base, and there is no room for error in the battle.

As for the mounts of the other two warriors, the Earth Dragon Beasts, they crashed directly into the shield.

The Earth Dragon Beasts have hard keratin armor, so they won't die for a while, but injuries are inevitable.

After Wang Shuo and the other two jumped into the opponent's camp, the opponent's camp's external defense immediately weakened.

"Quick, destroy them."

If the three were allowed to slaughter indiscriminately in the camp, they would lose directly.

However, if the generals who were defending the outside were called to besiege Wang Shuo and the other two, the formation of the spear and shield soldiers would be completely broken.

The charge of the Earth Dragon Beast Legion was unstoppable.

The opponent's main general was in a dilemma, and he had only a few breaths to think.

The Earth Dragon Beast rushed into the camp with an indomitable momentum.

Well, this time Wang Shuo and the other two didn't have to run away, and the opponent was directly caught in the massacre.

A few minutes later, the battle was over.

From the second round to now, Wang Shuo has lost 2 senior generals, 1 intermediate general and 5 junior generals.

The casualty ratio is very small.

After several rounds of competition, it soon entered the final decisive battle.

Wang Shuo undoubtedly became a seeded player.

In the semi-finals, the opponent used a sinister move to directly slaughter the junior generals, and Wang Shuo's generals suffered heavy losses.

Advancing to the finals, Wang Shuo only had 3 generals left, 2 senior generals, and 10 intermediate generals.

The junior generals had been killed.

The general who competed with Wang Shuo for the leadership was a general named Wu Minghui.

His troops were a group of heavy infantry.

Armed to the teeth, almost invincible in close combat.
